base_url_note: Paths are relative to the application base URL, for example http://localhost:5080.
common_preconditions: System time is Monday 2027-01-04 08:00 (shown in the page footer).
Seed data is as described in docs/test-data.md.

reset_step.expected: The message 'Test data has been reset.' is shown.

test_cases.title: Customer signs in with valid credentials
test_cases.description: A customer signs in with a valid e-mail and password and is shown as signed in.

steps.expected: The Sign in page with Email and Password fields is shown.

steps.action: Enter the e-mail and password and select 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The Home page opens and the header shows 'Signed in as Sara Al-Harbi'.

test_cases.title: Sign-in with a wrong password is rejected
test_cases.description: Invalid credentials keep the user signed out and show an error.

steps.expected: The Sign in page is shown.

steps.action: Enter the e-mail and a wrong password and select 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The message 'Invalid email or password.' is shown and the header still shows 'Sign in'.

test_cases.title: Customer cannot open the Add room page
test_cases.description: Admin-only pages are denied to customers.

steps.expected: The 'Access denied' page is shown with 'You do not have permission to open this page.'

test_cases.title: Customer room list shows active rooms only
test_cases.description: Customers see the active rooms and no admin controls.

steps.expected: The table lists exactly Al Nakheel (R-101), Al Waha (R-102) and Board Room (R-201) with their capacity and hourly rate.

steps.action: Check the page for Focus Pod and for an 'Add room' button.
steps.expected: Focus Pod is not listed, there is no 'Add room' button and no Status column.

test_cases.title: Admin room list shows all rooms with status
test_cases.description: Admins see active and inactive rooms.

steps.expected: Four rooms are listed. Al Nakheel, Al Waha and Board Room show status Active; Focus Pod (R-301) shows status Inactive. An 'Add room' button is shown.

test_cases.title: Admin adds a new room
test_cases.description: A valid room is created as Active with the next room ID.

steps.expected: The 'Add room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the room details and select 'Create room'.
steps.expected: The Rooms page shows 'Room Al Rawdah created with ID R-401.'
steps.data: Name: Al Rawdah; Capacity: 8; Hourly rate: 150

steps.action: Find Al Rawdah in the room list.
steps.expected: R-401 Al Rawdah is listed with capacity 8, hourly rate 150.00 SAR and status Active.

test_cases.title: Room with capacity 0 is rejected
test_cases.description: Capacity must be between 1 and 50.

steps.expected: The 'Add room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the room details and select 'Create room'.
steps.expected: The form stays open and shows 'Capacity must be between 1 and 50.'
steps.data: Name: Al Rawdah; Capacity: 0; Hourly rate: 150

test_cases.title: Duplicate room name is rejected
test_cases.description: Room names are unique.

steps.expected: The 'Add room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the room details and select 'Create room'.
steps.expected: The form stays open and shows "A room named 'Al Waha' already exists."
steps.data: Name: Al Waha; Capacity: 5; Hourly rate: 150

test_cases.title: Admin changes a room's hourly rate
test_cases.description: Edits are saved and shown in the room list.

steps.action: Open /Rooms and select 'Edit' for Al Nakheel.
steps.expected: The 'Edit room' form shows Room ID R-101, name Al Nakheel, capacity 6 and hourly rate 100.

steps.action: Change the hourly rate and select 'Save changes'.
steps.expected: The Rooms page shows 'Room Al Nakheel updated.' and Al Nakheel has hourly rate 120.00 SAR.

test_cases.title: Room with upcoming bookings cannot be deactivated
test_cases.description: Deactivation is blocked while confirmed future bookings exist.
preconditions: Board Room has upcoming booking BK-1003.

steps.action: Open /Rooms and select 'Deactivate' for Board Room.
steps.expected: The message 'Room Board Room has upcoming bookings and cannot be deactivated.' is shown and Board Room is still Active.

test_cases.title: Admin activates an inactive room
test_cases.description: An inactive room can be activated.

steps.action: Open /Rooms and select 'Activate' for Focus Pod.
steps.expected: The message 'Room Focus Pod activated.' is shown and Focus Pod has status Active.

test_cases.title: Search excludes booked and inactive rooms
test_cases.description: Al Nakheel is booked at the requested time and Focus Pod is inactive, so neither is offered.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: Available rooms are, in order: Al Waha at 300.00 SAR and Board Room at 600.00 SAR, each with 1 / 0 peak / off-peak hours. Al Nakheel and Focus Pod are not listed.

test_cases.title: Search filters rooms by capacity
test_cases.description: Only rooms that fit the attendees are offered.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: Only Board Room is listed, at 1,200.00 SAR.

test_cases.title: Slot ending after 22:00 is rejected
test_cases.description: Bookings must end by closing time.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: The message 'Bookings must start at 08:00 or later and end by 22:00.' is shown and no rooms are listed.

test_cases.title: Slot in the past is rejected
test_cases.description: Bookings must start after the current system time.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: The message 'The start time must be in the future.' is shown and no rooms are listed.

test_cases.title: Customer books a room at peak price
test_cases.description: A 2-hour weekday booking inside peak hours costs 1.5 times the rate.

steps.action: Open /Bookings/Search, enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: Al Waha is listed at 600.00 SAR with 2 / 0 peak / off-peak hours.
The booking page shows 'Booking BK-1005 confirmed.'
Status Confirmed, room Al Waha (R-102), date 2027-01-07, time 10:00 - 12:00 (2 h), attendees 6, price 600.00 SAR.

test_cases.title: Weekend hours are off-peak
test_cases.description: Friday has no peak hours.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: Al Nakheel is listed at 200.00 SAR with 0 / 2 peak / off-peak hours.

test_cases.title: Slot crossing the end of peak hours is priced per hour
test_cases.description: 16:00 to 18:00 on a weekday has one peak and one off-peak hour.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: Al Nakheel is listed at 250.00 SAR with 1 / 1 peak / off-peak hours.

test_cases.title: Four-hour booking gets a 10% discount
test_cases.description: The long-booking discount is shown in the search results.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: Al Nakheel is listed at 540.00 SAR with the note '(includes 10% discount of 60.00 SAR)' and 4 / 0 peak / off-peak hours.

test_cases.title: Evening long booking is off-peak and discounted
test_cases.description: 17:00 to 21:00 on Sunday has no peak hours and gets the long-booking discount.

steps.expected: The 'Find a room' form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the search criteria and select 'Search'.
steps.expected: Al Waha is listed at 720.00 SAR with the note '(includes 10% discount of 80.00 SAR)' and 0 / 4 peak / off-peak hours.

test_cases.title: Booking issues an invoice with discount and VAT
test_cases.description: The booking invoice shows the room line, the discount line, subtotal, 15% VAT and total.

steps.action: Open /Bookings/Search, enter the search criteria, select 'Search', then select 'Book' for Al Nakheel.
steps.expected: The booking page shows 'Booking BK-1005 confirmed.' and price 540.00 SAR.

steps.action: Under Invoices on the booking page, open INV-5005.
steps.expected: Invoice INV-5005 has type Booking and status Issued.

steps.action: Review the invoice lines and totals.
steps.expected: Lines: 'Al Nakheel, 4 h (4 peak, 0 off-peak)' 600.00 SAR and 'Long booking discount (10%)' -60.00 SAR. Subtotal 540.00 SAR, VAT (15%) 81.00 SAR, Total 621.00 SAR.

test_cases.title: Existing invoice shows discount and VAT
test_cases.description: A customer views a seeded invoice with a discount.

steps.expected: INV-5003 (BK-1003) and INV-5004 (BK-1004) are listed, both Booking and Issued.
Lines: 'Board Room, 4 h (4 peak, 0 off-peak)' 2,400.00 SAR and 'Long booking discount (10%)' -240.00 SAR. Subtotal 2,160.00 SAR, VAT (15%) 324.00 SAR, Total 2,484.00 SAR.

test_cases.title: Cancelling more than 24 hours ahead is free
test_cases.description: BK-1002 starts on 2027-01-06 13:00, more than 24 hours after the system time.

steps.expected: The cancellation page shows 'Cancellation fee: 0.00 SAR'.
The message 'Booking BK-1002 cancelled. Cancellation fee: 0.00 SAR.' is shown, status is Cancelled and the cancellation fee is 0.00 SAR.
INV-5002 has status Void. No cancellation fee invoice exists for BK-1002.

test_cases.title: Late cancellation charges 50% plus VAT
test_cases.description: BK-1001 starts on 2027-01-04 10:00, two hours after the system time.

steps.expected: The cancellation page shows 'Cancellation fee: 150.00 SAR (plus VAT 22.50 SAR)'.
The message 'Booking BK-1001 cancelled. Cancellation fee: 150.00 SAR.' is shown and status is Cancelled.
INV-5001 has status Void. INV-5005 for BK-1001 has type Cancellation fee, status Issued and total 172.50 SAR.

test_cases.title: Admin cancellation waives the fee
test_cases.description: An admin cancels a booking that would otherwise incur a late fee.

steps.expected: The cancellation page shows 'Cancellation fee: 0.00 SAR'.
The message 'Booking BK-1001 cancelled. Cancellation fee: 0.00 SAR.' is shown and status is Cancelled.

test_cases.title: Reschedule re-prices the booking and re-issues the invoice
test_cases.description: Moving BK-1002 from a weekday peak slot to Friday makes it off-peak.

steps.expected: The reschedule form shows date 2027-01-06, start 13:00, duration 2.

steps.action: Enter the new slot and select 'Save new time'.
steps.expected: The message 'Booking BK-1002 rescheduled. New price: 400.00 SAR.' is shown. Status Confirmed, date 2027-01-08, time 10:00 - 12:00.
steps.data: New date: 2027-01-08; New start time: 10:00; Duration: 2

steps.expected: INV-5002 has status Void. INV-5005 for BK-1002 has type Booking, status Issued and total 460.00 SAR.

test_cases.title: Reschedule into a booked slot is rejected
test_cases.description: Al Waha is booked by BK-1004 on 2027-01-07 14:00 - 16:00.

steps.expected: The reschedule form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the new slot and select 'Save new time'.
steps.expected: The form stays open and shows 'Room Al Waha is already booked at that time.'
steps.data: New date: 2027-01-07; New start time: 15:00; Duration: 1

steps.expected: The booking is unchanged: date 2027-01-06, time 13:00 - 15:00, price 600.00 SAR.

test_cases.title: Booking sends a confirmation notification
test_cases.description: The unread count increases and the message is listed.

steps.action: Open /Bookings/Search, enter the search criteria, select 'Search', then select 'Book' for Al Waha.
steps.expected: 'Booking BK-1005 confirmed.' is shown and the header shows 'Notifications (1)'.
The newest notification reads 'New: Booking BK-1005 confirmed: Al Waha on 2027-01-07 from 10:00 to 12:00.'
The header shows 'Notifications (0)'.

test_cases.title: Cancellation sends a notification with the fee
test_cases.description: The cancellation message states the fee.

steps.expected: The message 'Booking BK-1002 cancelled. Cancellation fee: 0.00 SAR.' is shown.
The newest notification reads 'New: Booking BK-1002 cancelled. Cancellation fee: 0.00 SAR.'

test_cases.title: Customer sees only their own bookings
test_cases.description: My bookings lists the signed-in customer's bookings only.

steps.expected: The 'My bookings' table lists exactly BK-1001 (Al Nakheel, 2027-01-04) and BK-1002 (Al Waha, 2027-01-06). BK-1003 and BK-1004 are not listed.

test_cases.title: Admin sees all bookings with customer names
test_cases.description: All bookings lists every booking.

steps.expected: The 'All bookings' table lists BK-1001 and BK-1002 for Sara Al-Harbi, and BK-1003 and BK-1004 for Omar Haddad.

test_cases.title: Customer cannot open another customer's booking
test_cases.description: Direct links to other customers' bookings are not found.

steps.expected: The 'Not found' page shows 'Booking not found.' and no booking details are shown.
